svg.title: AI Workload Chooser
svg.desc: Your content, such as text, documents, images, audio, video or a user request, branches into six AI workloads by the output required. Create new content: generative AI, using a chat or image-generation model. Take actions with tools: agentic AI, using Foundry Agent Service. Insights about text: text analysis, using Azure Language or a chat model. Convert between speech and text: speech, using Azure Speech. Interpret images or video: computer vision, using a multimodal model. Named fields as structured output: information extraction, using Azure Content Understanding.
svg.text: Name the workload from what the output must be, not from the file type.
Azure Language or a chat model
OUTPUT REQUIRED, WORKLOAD AND FOUNDRY OPTION
